claims.text: The data sources included varied text from conversational, literary, and religious sources, as well as news magazines and a book of proverbs.
Text was aggregated from a variety of online public-domain sources and physical books from personal libraries.
The dataset was significantly grown from a majority Biblical text corpus to millions of tokens from over a dozen sources.
Global Voices, a corpus of journalistic news text, was selected as a test set for modern, colloquial text.
